name: _section.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic/_section.scss — the shadow host and the .home-portfolio-section
//  wrapper (%MAXAREA column, section title). Imported by home-mosaic.scss
//  (manifest) — not compiled standalone. Visual styles only — geometry is
//  computed in JS.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Shadow host — fills parent width.
:host {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

// Section wrapper — %MAXAREA column.
// padding-top must clear the fixed .nav (top: $space-lg + ~$space-2xl row
// height ≈ 47px) with breathing room — 4xl (89px) keeps the title from
// sliding under the logo/burger on every breakpoint.
.home-portfolio-section {
  @extend %MAXAREA;
  width: 100%;
  padding-top: var(--space-4xl);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border-top: var(--space-hairline) solid transparent;
  border-image: var(--metallic-hairline) 1;
  background-image: var(--filament-glow);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding-bottom: var(--space-4xl);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    padding-bottom: var(--space-5xl);
  }

  .home-section-title {
    @extend %TTL_XL;

    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-weight: 100;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    text-align: left;
    padding-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
    color: var(--text-primary);
  }
}
